interface.signature: def lexicographicallySmallest(S: str, k: int) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S are lowercase English letters.
Length of S is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: If S is empty, return -1; otherwise, return a string or -1.
Return -1 if it's impossible to remove k characters (after correction) or if the result would be empty.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value) if return_value != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, it consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: (return_value != -1) == (len(return_value) == len(S) - k_corrected) if return_value != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, its length equals the length of S minus the corrected k (k_corrected).
If return_value is not -1, it is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by removing k_corrected characters from S.
